perspective:
From Angela Hwang’s perspective, she has access to:

- She is Angela Hwang, a hairdresser, and has been close friends with Kevin Flores since high school. She knows Kevin as a man, a construction worker, and her longtime friend.
- She noticed Kevin seemed unhappy with his construction job and invited him to coffee to talk.
- At coffee, she heard Kevin say he was “alright, just the usual grind,” then that he was not happy, felt stuck and unfulfilled, and was just going through the motions. He said he had thought about a different job/career but didn’t know where to start and felt overwhelmed. She offered to figure it out together; he agreed and thanked her.
- She found job openings and a career-counseling service and shared them with Kevin. He thanked her and said she “went all out.” He told her he had been thinking a lot and was interested in something more creative, maybe design or architecture. She encouraged him to check the resources; he said he would and that her support meant a lot.
- She believed Kevin was hesitant about changing careers and felt frustrated and worried. She arranged a meeting with a career coach. She told Kevin she believed in him and that the coach could help. He said she didn’t have to, appreciated it, but wasn’t sure he was ready. She said she understood his hesitation but sometimes a push helps. He agreed to give it a shot. She promised support every step of the way.
- She believed Kevin was making progress and felt proud and relieved. She checked in with him about the career coach. Kevin told her the coach was helpful, he had started online courses in design, and he felt more confident. She said she was proud and offered more help. He said just knowing she was there was enough and that he’d ask if he needed anything.
- She believed Kevin had successfully transitioned to a new career and felt happy and satisfied. She organized a small celebration party for him. She told Kevin about it and that he deserved it. He thanked her and said he was grateful and couldn’t have done it without her. She said he did the hard work and she was glad to support him. They celebrated.

She does not have access to Kevin’s private thoughts, hidden narrator-only facts, or anything he did not tell or show her.
